thread:
mia: Heads-up — SunField asked for a delivery playbook for the deal. They want a short timeline, which model variants we'll serve, security questionnaire answers, and a cost ballpark. Can we assemble by EOD tomorrow?

sam_customer: Thanks Mia. Use case: customer support triage + summarization. Target ~10–15 req/s, 2k token sessions, goal P95 latency <200ms. Data is customer support logs (PII redaction needed). Prefer open models but happy to consider quantized variants.

raj: Ok noted. Quick Qs: is inference allowed in hosted mode or must be private/VPC?

sam_customer: Hosted is fine for now, but they may push for VPC for PHI later. Need KMS for keys.

elsa: KMS requirement flagged. We'll need to confirm key residency + access logs. Also: do they require an incident response SLA & SOC2 attestation?

sam_customer: SOC2 is required. Incident SLA is negotiable — they'd like 4hr initial response.

linda: For SOC2 + KMS we should map to our Private offering or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS. Legal will need to see dataflow diagram and subprocessor list. I'll start a template.

tom: From infra side, hitting P95 <200ms at 15 req/s with 2k tokens implies either Dedicated pool (multi-GPU) or hosted with aggressive batching disabled. KV cache will help for repeated context. If they want hosted but KMS, we can do envelope encryption with customer-managed keys (requires paperwork).

raj: Proposal idea: serve two variants — a high-accuracy 13B float16 for conversational context (hosted), and a 13B-int8/4bit quant variant for throughput & cost (dedicated burst). Auto-fallback policy if high-cost variant unavailable.

mia: Can you sketch an ops playbook + ownership? Sales needs bullet list for the customer and the security questionnaire answers.

raj: Draft playbook (short):
- Discovery (owner: mia): confirm throughput, PII scope, residency
- Security review (owner: elsa + linda): KMS/residency, SOC2 evidence, questionnaire
- Architecture decision (owner: tom + raj): hosted vs dedicated, model variants, KV caching config
- Cost sizing (owner: raj): token estimate + variant mix + burst pricing
- Pilot (owner: raj + tom): 2-week pilot with traffic simulator
- Handoff & contract (owner: mia + linda): finalize SLA, KMS terms

raj: Quick config snippet for the pilot (informal):
```
model_routing:
  - route: low_latency
    model: open-13b-fp16
    batch_size: 4
    max_seq: 2048
  - route: high_throughput
    model: open-13b-quant-4bit
    batch_size: 32
    cache: enabled
fallback_policy: prefer_low_latency_then_quant
billing_estimate: "~$3.2/token-unit for fp16, $0.9/token-unit for quant (rough)"
```

elsa: For the security questionnaire: I'll provide a one-pager covering SOC2, KMS integration (we support AWS KMS & GCP KMS with envelope keys), data retention policies, and access logs. Need sample ATO docs?

linda: Also add standard contractual clauses for data processing. I'll attach a redline-ready addendum for KMS control and a clause for data residency.

mia: Pricing note — customer will push for committed pricing. Raj, can you produce a 3-tier commit option (trial, monthly commit, 12mo commit) with estimated unit costs?

raj: Yep. I'll do trial (metered + small free credits), monthly reserved with small discount, 12mo commit with deeper discount + dedicated pool option. Will include a run-rate breakeven table.

tom: Operational blockers I see:
- KMS paperwork + technical onboarding (1–2 weeks)
- If they move to VPC/private, we need network setup window (2–3 weeks)
- For P95 <200ms we must limit batching for low-latency route; this increases cost.

sam_customer: Good visibility. Is there any upfront infra work we should budget for on our side?

raj: Minimal for hosted. If you go Dedicated/VPC: firewall rules, peering config, and KMS access tests. We'll provide the checklist.

mia: Action items before EOD tomorrow:
- raj: cost tiers + pilot config + rough timeline (deliverable)
- elsa: security one-pager + questionnaire answers (deliverable)
- linda: contract addendum draft for KMS/residency (deliverable)
- tom: ops note on latency tradeoffs and sample infra checklist (deliverable)
- mia: combine into single playbook PDF and send to Sam

deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created: https://redwood.internal/checklists/deal-playbook-1789999000 :white_check_mark:

sam_customer: Thanks team — we'll review once you send. Happy to hop on a quick sync if needed later today.

mia: I'll book 30m after we share the doc. Thanks all :pray:
